name: European Refrigeration Disruption Campaign
summary: Coordinated cyber-sabotage targeting supermarket and healthcare refrigeration systems across 8 European nations, manipulating OT interfaces to destroy perishable goods and blood products, prompting joint CISA/FBI emergency warnings.

name: APT29 Plerdy Supply Chain Campaign
summary: Russian SVR (APT29) hijacking the Plerdy SEO Tracker script to deliver mobile zero-day exploit chains via watering hole attacks on high-value websites.

name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Combined kinetic ballistic/drone strikes and hybrid operations targeting Ukrainian power generation, nuclear plant grid interconnects, transport bridges, and regional infrastructure ahead of winter.

name: North Korean Agentic AI Cyber Espionage Operations
summary: North Korean state-sponsored threat groups using rigged coding assignments and trojanized AI tools to compromise engineers, resulting in large-scale cryptocurrency heists.

name: Ukrainian Strategic Counter-Refinery Deep Strike Wave
summary: Ukrainian Neptune cruise missile and drone strikes targeting Russian military-industrial facilities, optoelectronic plants, and regional refinery logistics.

name: VAPOR PANDA Agentic AI Reconnaissance Campaign
summary: China-nexus threat actor using the ARTEX multi-agent AI framework and commercial LLMs to automate simultaneous global intrusions against government and defense targets.

name: Storm-3358 ARTEX Financial Exploitation Wave
summary: Cambodia-based cybercriminal cluster weaponizing the ARTEX agentic framework to scan, breach, and deploy WISP, vshell, and AdaptixC2 RATs across global and regional financial institutions.

name: European Aviation and Public Transit Bomb Hoax Campaign
summary: Coordinated wave of anonymous bomb threats disrupting dozens of commercial European flights, triggering fighter scrambles in Hungary, and targeting Irish media organizations ahead of the Dublin EPC summit.
